name: LoginFlow
description:
A complete, configurable authentication flow: password sign-in with an email, username or
either; third-party providers; remember me; a two-factor code step; forgot and reset
password; and optional account creation. The host supplies async callbacks and owns every
backend contract, URL and brand; the flow owns validation, pending and outcome feedback in
place, focus, and the animated change between views.

Route it with `view`/`onViewChange` (and `getViewHref` for real links), or leave it
uncontrolled. The entered identifier is kept across views.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the first empty field when the flow mounts: a dedicated sign-in page or a sign-in dialog. Default false.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer element's placement.

props.name: defaultIdentifier
props.description: Prefills the identifier (a remembered email). The entered identifier is kept across views.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: The initial view when uncontrolled. Default "sign-in".

props.name: footer
props.description: Below the flow: legal links or support contact.

props.name: getViewHref
props.description:
A URL for each routed view. View links then render as real links (open in a new tab,
copy address); a plain click still calls `onViewChange` without navigating.

props.name: header
props.description: Above the view heading: the host's logo or product name.

props.name: heading
props.description: Render each view's title. Set false when a Dialog header or page title already names the view. Default true.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the view title. Use 1 on a dedicated sign-in page. Default 2.

props.name: id
props.description: Element id of the outer element.

props.name: identifier
props.description: What people sign in with. Sets the label, `autocomplete` and validation. Default "email".

props.name: labels
props.description: Visible copy. Any subset; the rest keeps the factual defaults.

props.name: onError
props.description: Receives errors thrown by callbacks (other than `LoginError`) for logging. The view shows `labels.unexpectedError`.

props.name: onProviderSignIn
props.description: Starts a provider sign-in (normally a redirect). Resolves like `onSignIn`.

props.name: onRequestPasswordReset
props.description: Sends a password reset. Enables "Forgot password?".

props.name: onResendTwoFactor
props.description: Sends another two-factor code. Offers "Send a new code" with the resend cooldown.

props.name: onResetPassword
props.description: Verifies a reset code and sets the new password in place. Without it, the reset view only confirms the email.

props.name: onSignIn
props.description:
Password sign-in. Resolve with nothing or `{ status: "success" }`, an error outcome, or
`{ status: "two-factor" }` to ask for a code. Omit for a providers-only flow.

props.name: onSignUp
props.description: Creates an account. Enables the sign-up view and its link.

props.name: onVerifyTwoFactor
props.description: Checks a two-factor code. Required when `onSignIn` or `onProviderSignIn` can return `two-factor`.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called with the next view when a link, outcome or back action changes it.

props.name: passwordPolicy
props.description: Rules for a new password (sign-up and reset). The server still enforces its own policy.

props.name: providerLayout
props.description: list: one full-width button per row. grid: two columns of short buttons. auto (default): grid from four providers.

props.name: providerPlacement
props.description: Where the providers sit relative to the password form. Default "above".

props.name: providers
props.description: Third-party sign-in options, in display order.

props.name: remember
props.description: Show "Keep me signed in". `true` starts unticked. Default false.

props.name: resendCooldown
props.description: Seconds before a reset email or code can be sent again. Default 30; 0 disables the cooldown.

props.name: resetCode
props.description: Reset code shape for `onResetPassword`. Default 6 digits.

props.name: signUp
props.description: Sign-up fields.

props.name: surface
props.description: Draw the flow on its own panel surface (a page canvas). Set false inside a Dialog, Sheet or Panel. Default true.

props.name: view
props.description: The controlled view, when the host routes it. Pair with `onViewChange`.
